note: One trusted TSA root: the FreeTSA Root CA for the FreeTSA public RFC 3161 service at https://freetsa.org/tsr, selected by the owner on 2026-11-12 (docs/releases/V6_0_13_G4_TSA_OWNER_SELECTION_2026-11-12.md). The PEM is byte-identical to https://freetsa.org/files/cacert.pem as retrieved and corroborated on 2026-11-12. sha256 is the DER SHA-256 of that certificate. No fallback TSA is trusted. Adding, replacing or removing a root is an owner decision and needs an independent audit.
